The Uncle's Unexpected Compliment

Rathore residence · Shreya in the same red gym outfit · Arvind (unrelated elder called Uncle) · Anaya cared for separately

PUBLISHED · SCENE 02 PART B

Canon correction: Arvind is not Shreya's father-in-law and is not blood related to Vikram. Vikram met him through a past accident and hospitalization, then invited him into their household. Shreya calls him Uncle. Any attraction is Arvind's own, not mutual or implied consent. Anaya's care is a separate, ordinary family responsibility.
<div class="a02-prose">
07:57 AM — The memory follows her home

Gulmohar Heights ka corridor almost quiet tha. Shreya gym bag kandhe par liye ghar ki taraf badhi. Vivek ka attraction-resistance challenge khatam ho chuka tha, par uski close stance, defined abs aur woh unexpected kiss baar-baar yaad aa rahe the. Police Inspector ki poori confidence ke bawajood, ek pal ke liye uska focus kaise fisal gaya tha!
Vivek... tumne sach mein mujhe hara diya. Aur phir dinner mein Vikram ko bhi invite kiya. Interesting.

Shreya ko khud par hansi aayi. Woh jaanti thi ki athletic abs aur sharp muscle definition uski private weakness thi, lekin aaj usne us weakness ko sabke saamne nahi, ek intimate aur voluntary challenge mein discover kiya tha. Usne door unlock kiya.
07:59 AM — Arvind Uncle

Living room mein Arvind Uncle the. Unhone Anaya ko kuch der pehle sambhala tha; bachchi ab apne kamre mein thi. Arvind parivaar ke blood relative nahi the. Saalon pehle Vikram se jude ek accident aur hospital stay ke baad unka ghar se rishta bana tha, aur Shreya hamesha unhe Uncle hi kehti thi.
Shreya: Good morning, Uncle! Meri princess ne zyada pareshan toh nahi kiya?
Arvind: Bilkul nahi. Lekin achha hua tum aa gayi. Anaya ko bhookh lag rahi thi, tumhe dhoondh rahi thi.
Shreya: Oh! Main time ka dhyaan hi nahi rakh paayi. Main use dekhti hoon.
Arvind ki nazar uske red workout outfit par thahar gayi. Kuch pal woh kuch bole hi nahi. Shreya ne unki khamoshi notice ki.
Shreya: Kya hua, Uncle? Aise kya dekh rahe hain?
Arvind: Kuch nahi. Bas aaj tumhara andaaz alag lag raha hai.
Shreya: Achha? Roz police uniform mein dekhkar bore ho gaye?
Arvind: Uniform mein toh tum sabko discipline sikhaati ho. Aaj lagta hai saamne waalon ka discipline hi test ho jaaye.
Vivek ka balance-challenge Shreya ko yaad aa gaya. Is baar usne apni expression sambhali.
Shreya: Uncle! Aaj aap bhi gym waalon ki tarah double-meaning baatein karne lage?
Arvind: Nahi, nahi, mera woh matlab nahi tha.
Shreya: Toh kya matlab tha?
Arvind ek pal ko chup hue. Phir unhone nazar milane ki koshish ki.
Arvind: Bas... tum aaj bahut sexy lag rahi ho.
Shreya ki smile ruk gayi. Vivek ke saath jo playful energy thi, yahan uska context bilkul alag tha. Arvind se aisa compliment usne expect nahi kiya tha.
Shreya: Uncle! Yeh kya keh diya aapne?
Arvind: Sorry, sorry! Galat bol gaya. Flow mein nikal gaya. Bura mat maanna.
Arvind ki nazar phir ek pal uske sports top ki taraf gayi. Shreya ne seedhe unki taraf dekhkar baat rok di.
Shreya: Uncle, meri taraf dekhiye. Aapki nazar baar-baar neeche ja rahi hai.
Arvind: Haan... sorry, Shreya. Mujhe aise nahi dekhna chahiye tha.
Shreya: Aap bhi na. Aaj subah sabko kya ho gaya hai?
Arvind: Theek hai, main chalta hoon. Anaya ko dekh lena.
Arvind jaldi se doosre kamre ki taraf chale gaye. Shreya kuch pal chup rahi. Unka unusual compliment aur apologetic exit uske dimaag mein reh gaya, lekin usne uska koi romantic matlab nahi nikala.
Pehle Vivek ne mera concentration bigaada... aur ab Uncle ka yeh unexpected compliment. What a morning.
08:04–08:12 AM — Back to duty

Shreya Anaya ko dekhne gayi aur uski routine needs ka khayal rakha. Phir jaldi se freshen up karke duty uniform pehni, bag aur files li. Vikram se ek short goodbye exchange ke baad 08:12 par lobby ki taraf nikli. Gym ki private memory, Arvind ki awkward comment aur police duty—teeno alag duniyaan—ab ek hi subah ka hissa the.

SHREYA SR04 · 08:15–08:20 AM · PUBLISHED

The Chairman's Weak Spot — Shreya & Mahendra

Gulmohar Heights security desk · 1 January 2026 · Shreya Rathore (33) and society chairman Mahendra Suri (61)

PUBLISHED · USER-APPROVED

Continuity: SR05 twins conversation ends at 08:15. Mahendra is the only other adult present in this SR04 beat; Chintu is deliberately reserved for Shreya Episode 03. The playful dialogue occurs alongside a real register-entry discrepancy. Shreya departs for duty at 08:20.
<div class="a02-prose">
Shreya parking se security desk ki taraf badhi. Karan aur Aman ki flustered reactions yaad karke uske chehre par abhi bhi ek mischievous smile thi. Mahendra Suri visitor register lekar khade the.
Mahendra: Good morning, Inspector Rathore. Ek chhoti si problem hai.
Shreya: Good morning, Chairman sahab. Problem register mein hai ya aapke dil mein?
Mahendra hans pade.
Mahendra: Arre wah! Aaj toh aap bade romantic mood mein hain.
Shreya: Aapne abhi tak problem batayi hi nahi. Kahin mujhe dekhkar bhool toh nahi gaye?
Mahendra: Sach kahun? Thoda sa.
Shreya: Achha ji? Itni jaldi concentration lose kar diya?
Mahendra ne register khola.
Mahendra: Dekhiye, entry time aur vehicle slip match nahi kar rahe.
Shreya unke paas aakar register dekhne lagi.
Shreya: Yeh dekhiye. Vehicle 07:40 par enter hui, lekin register mein 07:55 likha hai.
Mahendra: Aapki nazar bahut tez hai.
Shreya: Sirf nazar nahi, Chairman sahab. Main logon ke expressions bhi notice karti hoon.
Mahendra: Toh mere expression mein kya dikh raha hai?
Shreya ne register band kiya aur seedha unki aankhon mein dekha.
Shreya: Ek gentleman jo official kaam ke bahaane personal compliments dena chahta hai.
Mahendra ek second ke liye chup ho gaye.
Mahendra: Aap toh bina interrogation ke hi sab pakad leti hain.
Shreya: Abhi toh maine interrogation shuru bhi nahi kiya.
Mahendra: Aur agar kar diya?
Shreya: Phir aapko mere har sawaal ka sach-sach jawab dena padega.
Mahendra: Aap sawaal poochiye. Main ready hoon.
Shreya ne shararat se eyebrow raise ki.
Shreya: Achha? Toh bataiye, Chairman sahab... aapki nazar kitni baar register se hatkar meri taraf gayi?
Mahendra zor se hans pade.
Mahendra: Inspector sahiba, itna difficult sawaal mat poochiye.
Shreya: Kyun? Counting bhool gaye?
Mahendra: Counting toh yaad hai. Bas answer dene mein sharam aa rahi hai.
Shreya: Waah! Itni age mein bhi sharmaate hain aap?
Mahendra: Kuch logon ke saamne umar ka experience bhi kaam nahi aata.
Shreya muskuraayi.
Shreya: Phir toh aapko apni concentration par kaam karna padega. Varna agli baar main aur tough questions poochungi.
Mahendra: Aur main jawab dene ke liye phir haazir ho jaunga.
Shreya: Dekhte hain. Filhaal visitor register correct karwa dijiye.
Woh aage badhi, phir palatkar boli—
Shreya: Aur Chairman sahab... agli baar mujhe dekhkar apna kaam mat bhooliyega.
Mahendra: Koshish karunga. Guarantee nahi de sakta.
Shreya hanste hue parking exit ki taraf chal di.
Yeh bhi achhe khaase confident hain. Lekin tease karne par inka expression dekhne layak tha.

08:20 AM — Shreya apni gaadi ki taraf badhi. Visitor log ki original entries ko preserve karke discrepancy note karne ki instruction woh Mahendra ko de chuki thi. Ab police station ke liye nikalna tha.

SHREYA SR07 · 09:00–09:35 AM · PUBLISHED

The Inspector's Favourite Troublemakers — Rohas & Lokesh

Gurgaon police station · Briefing room · Shreya, trainees Rohas and Lokesh (both 24), Sub-Inspector Poonam (29)

PUBLISHED · USER-REQUESTED

Continuity: Shreya's first/top uniform button stays OPEN throughout SR07; she has not opened any further button. Her tongue-bite, surprise, blush, enjoying the suggestive banter and Vivek-memory loop remain in character. Rohas and Lokesh are trainees, not twins. Poonam arrives around 09:12 to move the scene into an actual case briefing.
<div class="a02-prose">

09:00 AM. Shreya briefing room mein files arrange kar rahi thi. Uniform neatly pressed thi, aur top collar button ab bhi open tha—SR05 se wahi single button. Usne doosra button nahi khola tha. Gym challenge aur Vivek ke saath kiss ki memory kabhi-kabhi use distract kar rahi thi.
Tabhi Rohas aur Lokesh andar aaye. Dono 24 saal ke adult police trainees the; brothers ya twins nahi, lekin Shreya ke favourite mischievous colleagues ban chuke the.
Rohas: Good morning, ma'am! Aaj hum dono ke liye koi special training hai?
Shreya: Good morning. Tum dono ko dekhkar toh lag raha hai extra training ki bahut zaroorat hai.
Lokesh: Training se problem nahi hai, ma'am. Bas instructor achhi honi chahiye.
Shreya: Instructor ki tension mat lo. Main tum dono ko achhe se handle kar sakti hoon.
Rohas: Dono ko ek saath, ma'am? Itna confidence!
Shreya ne playful challenge dete hue apni pen table par rakhi.
Shreya: Kyun? Tum dono ke liye alag-alag sessions rakhne padenge?
Lokesh: Individual attention mile toh performance naturally better hoti hai.
Shreya: Achha? Toh asli demand individual attention ki hai?
Rohas: Demand nahi, ma'am. Bas dekhna hai aapka attention kitni der hold kar sakte hain.
Shreya muskuraayi.
Shreya: Pehle dekhna padega tum dono mein stamina kitna hai. Kahin do minute mein hi surrender na kar do.
Baat kehte hi Shreya ne apni zubaan halki si daanton ke beech daba li. Usse apni hi line ka double meaning samajh aa gaya.
Oh God, Shreya! Yeh kya bol diya?
Rohas ki mischievous smile aur badh gayi. Dono conversational distance tak kareeb aaye.
Rohas: Do minute? Ma'am, hamare stamina ko itna underestimate mat kijiye. Hum toh lambi innings ke liye aaye hain.
Lokesh: Aur agar hum dono ek-ek karke aaye, toh sochiye... aap hum dono ke challenges jhel paayengi?
Lokesh ne wink kiya. Shreya ki eyebrows surprise mein uth gayin aur uske gaalon par halka blush aa gaya.
Shreya: Excuse me! Tum dono training ki baat kar rahe ho na?
Rohas: Bilkul, ma'am. Aap kis training ke baare mein soch rahi hain?
Lokesh: Lagta hai ma'am ne hamari innocent baat ka koi aur matlab nikaal liya.
Shreya ne aankhein narrow karke dono ko dekha. Unki playful confidence use unexpectedly entertaining lag rahi thi.
Shreya: Oh, really? Tum dono bahut shaatir hote ja rahe ho.
Rohas: Aapki training ka effect hai, ma'am.
Shreya: Toh phir ek baat yaad rakhna. Main challenge dene ke baad aasani se peeche nahi hatt-ti.
Lokesh: Aur hum bhi easily give up nahi karte.
Shreya hansi. Embarrassment ke saath ek mischievous excitement bhi thi. Woh unki witty teasing enjoy kar rahi thi, bina apna gym wala secret reveal kiye.
Yeh dono toh Samar-Shaan se bhi kam nahi hain!
Shreya: Achha, Mr. Stamina aur Mr. Confidence. Ab batao, physical assessment kaun pehle dega?
Rohas: Ladies first?
Shreya: Main examiner hoon!
Lokesh: Toh phir Rohas first. Main observe karunga ki ma'am ise kitni jaldi haraati hain.
Rohas: Bhai, tu mera partner hai ya opposition?
Shreya: Relax, gentlemen. Tum dono ko poora mauka milega. Lekin meri training mein shortcuts nahi chalte.
Rohas ne exaggerated salute kiya.
Rohas: Yes, ma'am. Full dedication.
Lokesh: Aur full concentration.
Shreya: Woh toh abhi se doubtful lag rahi hai!
Teeno hans pade.
09:12 AM — Poonam interrupts
Door par knock hua. Poonam (29), Sub-Inspector aur Shreya ki investigation colleague, files lekar andar aayi.
Poonam: Ma'am, sorry to interrupt. Witness statement aur vehicle movement log mein fifteen-minute mismatch mila hai.
Shreya ne turant file li aur professional tone mein briefing shuru ki.
Shreya: Original entries preserve karo. Kavita se CCTV timestamps verify karwao, Meera se independent timeline banwao.
Poonam: Yes, ma'am. Aur Rohas-Lokesh?
Shreya ne dono ki taraf dekha.
Shreya: In dono ko bhi kaam do. Inka stamina aaj bahut discuss ho raha hai.
Poonam ko background joke ka context nahi pata tha. Rohas aur Lokesh ek-doosre ko dekhkar muskura diye.
Poonam: Fine. Dono evidence review mein help karenge.
Shreya: Perfect. Dekhte hain kaun kitni der concentrate kar paata hai.
Rohas: Bhai, lagta hai aaj sach mein test hone wala hai.
Lokesh: Maine pehle hi kaha tha. Inspector madam ke saath challenge soch-samajhkar accept karna.
Shreya: I can hear you, gentlemen.
Dono ek saath seedhe khade ho gaye.
Rohas & Lokesh: Sorry, ma'am!
Shreya apni smile chhupate hue report padhne lagi.
Favourite troublemakers. Inhe serious rakhna bhi ek full-time duty hai.

09:15 AM par teasing khatam hui. 09:35 AM tak Shreya, Poonam aur team ne contradictory timestamps ko flag kiya, original log preserve kiya aur next witness verification schedule ki. Shreya abhi police station mein hi thi.

Arvind’s private POV — Shreya physically absent, on duty at police station

PUBLISHED · USER-APPROVED

Arvind outer storage area mein aaya. Wahan Shreya ka gym bag thoda ajeeb angle se pada tha, zip half open, aur kuch kapda andar se bahar nikal ke atka hua tha. Woh bag ko utha ke theek se shelf pe rakhne laga.

Jab usne stuck kapda andar theek kiya, tab usko feel hua ki fabric thoda damp hai. Bag ke andar se subah ke workout clothes dikh gaye — red sports bra aur matching pants. Kapda abhi bhi paseene se geela tha. Sports bra ke andar wale hisse pe milk leakage ka halka white mark bhi saaf dikh raha tha.

Arvind ne bag ko shelf pe rakh diya, lekin haath ruk gaya. Usne bra ko ek second ke liye haath mein liya. Kapda garam aur thoda chipchipa laga. Usne pehle naram sa smell liya — fresh workout sweat aur uski body ka scent. Saans tez ho gayi. Phir dheere se usne bra ko munh ke paas laaya aur milk stain wale hisse ko lick kiya. Ek dheemi groan nikal gayi.

Subah wali Shreya turant dimaag mein aa gayi — red outfit mein confident, thodi si sweat se chamakti hui, uski taraf muskura ke dekh rahi thi. Imagination mein woh uske saamne bra utaar rahi thi, milky breasts fully exposed, nipples thode stiff, milk ki halki leakage abhi bhi.
Phir usne pants bhi haath mein liye. Intimate area ke damp fabric ko usne deeply smell kiya, phir tongue se lick kiya. Doosri groan tez ho gayi.

Uske mind mein scene aur gahra ho gaya. Shreya gym mein forward bend kar rahi hai, pants tight aur sweat se chipki hui, aur woh usse dekh ke jaanti hai ki woh kahan dekh raha hai. Phir woh uske paas aati hai, uski haath pakad ke apni bra ke andar le jaati hai, uski ungliyon ko milk-damp skin pe feel karwati hai.
Arvind ne aankhein kholi. Woh abhi bhi akela tha. Bag ab theek se shelf pe pada tha. Shreya police station mein thi, bilkul unaware.
Usne clothes wapas bag mein rakh diye, zip band ki, aur room se nikal gaya. Lekin andar jo obsession jaag gayi thi, woh ab easily nahi jaane wali thi.
